gen-gf-underdog-gf-google-sans-flex: Underdog draws its curves in one unwavering line, with a horseshoe-wide c that announces itself from across the room. Google Sans Flex follows in cleanly cut sans strokes.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-gothic-a1: Loud, wiry and sure of itself, Underdog holds a single pen-like line from start to finish. And Gothic A1, a plain sans with a splayed c terminal, keeps the text friendly and unfussy.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-gotu: Underdog looks laser-cut: one stroke width, every curve the same. It leads with that stamped-out punch, while Gotu does the quieter job, its arch shoulders thinning slowly into lighter joins for steady reading.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-gowun-dodum: Big, round and bold in attitude, Underdog keeps its line unchanging around every curve. And Gowun Dodum, a plain sans with a wide-mouthed a and tube-smooth strokes, gives the pairing its softness.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-gruppo: Gruppo brings sans-serif letters whose curve endings never come near each other, and Underdog above it looks traced with a single marker tip. But the two sit like a shout beside a murmur, each one clearly itself.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-hanken-grotesk: Hanken Grotesk reads like bent wire, with wide channels leading into every counter, so the sans-serif text moves along easily. And Underdog above it adds a loud horseshoe c, giving the page a confident headline voice.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-host-grotesk: Underdog cuts every curve to one line width, like sign-shop vinyl, with a c opened wide as a horseshoe. Host Grotesk then sweeps its curves open, so paragraphs flow without a snag.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-hubot-sans: Wirelike and brash, Underdog keeps one thickness through every curve. But Hubot Sans, with its widely opened e, is the one that makes running sans text feel modern and approachable.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-ibm-plex-sans-arabic: IBM Plex Sans Arabic has openly readable apertures that make the sans text easy to follow, while Underdog above it traces glyphs at one thickness. Give the heading extra size to let it stand out.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-ibm-plex-sans-devanag: Loose, rope-like curves that never knot at the ends give the text a modern, relaxed flow. IBM Plex Sans Devanagari sits under Underdog, whose untapered strokes and horseshoe c add the shout.
